$comment: The Smart components whose bare tag keeps its box before its code from a core rule (src/core/scss/_sf_css__placeholder.scss): what the rule holds (box: width and height; height: the height and the top, the width being its text's) and the attributes it reads. Gate 24b (tests/browser/first-paint-gate.browser.mjs) fails a bare tag of these that moves when its code arrives; every other component's bare jump is reported, not failed. A component joins the list in the same change as its core rule (first-paint study R222, 2026-11-13); the ten that already held their box joined with the first-paint status of 2026-11-16 (R222/R223). A covered component is loaded FIRST_PAINT_BARE_LOADS times (3) at the first width and at 390. core_rule false: the component holds without a rule of core (no box of its own, or its children hold theirs).

breadcrumbs.reads: nothing but its items written inside: until the element is defined the host holds the trail's one line at the 1/3 control height, its items out of view (RG-S2-5, 2026-11-15; joined the gate with the first-paint status R222, 2026-11-16)

button-icon.reads: size (1/3, 1/2, 1, 2, 3), height (low, high, highest for sizes 1, 2 and 3), href and hidden: a square of the size's line plus its height step on each side, as the icon-buttons sheet draws it, a block as the drawn button or link is; a link (href) as wide as its container and never narrower than the square. Height, not box: a cycle's live text is sr-only (1 px with a -1 px margin) and widens the drawn union by one pixel to the left (GB17A-1, 2026-11-23: a bare size 1/2 icon button in a table row grew the row 22 -> 30 at 390). The width is held too and has its own case: tests/browser/button-icon-bare-box.browser.mjs holds the drawn box, width and height, for every size, height, a button and a link, in a block, a flex row, a table cell and a line of text (GB17B-1, 2026-11-23: a bare link in an auto-width cell or a flex row was 0 wide until its code)

drawer.reads: nothing: a closed side panel is out of the page flow before its code and after (display none until defined, DR-13), so it holds no box and moves nothing (first-paint status R222)

editor-inline.reads: nothing: the inline editor draws no box of its own around the page's text it edits, before its code and after (first-paint status R222)

editor-overlay.reads: nothing: the overlay editor draws no box in the page before its code and after (first-paint status R222)

header-page.reads: the slots the page gives (path, actions and their sizes, tabs) and expressive: the one-line head at every width, the path row, the tabs row (RG-S2-5, 2026-11-15); a heading too long for its row beside the kept actions at 320 is gate-known.json's

header-site.reads: size: the site header's bar of its size step, its slot content out of view until the element is defined (HD-13); a 1/2 bar whose tools, or nav and actions above its collapse step, hold a size-1 control (a button, segmented, language or menu of size 1 or none) holds the size-1 bar (RG-S2-7, 2026-11-16)

input.reads: size (1/3, 1/2, 1, 2, 3), label, hint, invalid with error-message, appearance=hidden: one control of the size step as wide as its container, plus one line of the text a step below and the field's gap for a label and for a message (pilot of R222, 2026-11-13)

language.reads: size and mode: one control of the size step high; as wide as high only for mode menu and search, the switch and auto take the width of their labels (Docara, 2026-11-07)

list-item.reads: size, kind, supporting, lines, sortable-item and pinned, and its list's leading kind: the row's control height, its supporting line and its leading room (LI-6, 2026-11-14)

profile-picker.reads: size (1/2, 1): the folded trigger, one control of its size as wide as the line (first-paint status R222, FP-7)

reference-link.reads: appearance, size (1/2, 1, 2; retired 1/3 and 3 as their kept steps), line and text: as wide as its container; a card one control of size 3, a size one control of its step, a line or plain one line of its text; a card with text holds its route under the name at every width, the card's padding and border, the name's line and the route's 1/2 line (C236; 78 at 1440, 62 at 390); on a phone a plain reference stacks to the label line, the gap and a route line when text is set (RL-18, 2026-11-14); appearance=inline is no box: inline, its label written in the link's ink until the element draws (C147, 2026-11-14)

sortable.reads: nothing but its children: its rows are the page's list items, each holding its own box (first-paint status R222)

tag-group.reads: layout (row or wrap) and its tags: the row's box, its tags 4 apart, each tag holding its own box (C145 (3))

wizard-step.reads: nothing: a step is drawn by its sf-wizard and has no box of its own before or after its code (first-paint status R222)
